sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: estimate); size 457 x 292 x 51 mm (w x d x h) (axis order assumed); port and control positions are placeholders until measured

Arrakis ARC-8 brochure, opened 2026-11-12 (a text PDF): width 18 in, depth 11 1/2 in, height 2 in (the order is labelled; the plan keeps its axis-assumed grade); 8 input channels (2 mic, 5 stereo line, 1 selectable PC USB or line), the rear-panel diagram labels XLR mic inputs, balanced program outputs (XLR), unbalanced RCA outputs and inputs, a 1/8 in headphone jack, a USB sound-card port, a 12 VDC input from an external power module (no mains inlet) and an optional 48 V phantom module. The counts behind most callouts are in the picture only and are NOT stated in text, so the connector set is not documented: beta-modelled, with 2 mic inputs, the stereo program output (one XLR per side, assumed) and the headphone jack as a stand-in. The profile is an estimate (flat, "only 2 in high"). Generic artwork only (content/generic-panels/<id>.json, drawn by npm run asset:panel): connectors, faders, knobs and screens drawn without lettering, no photo, no logo. Every port and control position is a guess (confidence guess) and the side profile is an estimate drawn from the three outer sizes (no drawing opened). Connector genders not stated by the source follow the convention input = female, output = male.
